When the clonal cellular population is composed of lymphocytes, it is classified as chronic lymphocytic leukemia, hairy cell leukemia, or T-cell large granular lymphocyte leukemia.

breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 研发免复杂配型的超快精准溶栓与导管微取栓器械、阻断微血栓级联炎症风暴药物，以及在缺血缺氧期守住心肌与脑神经元存活的细胞保护剂。

The following histologic patterns have been described: conventional squamous cell carcinoma, papillary squamous cell carcinoma, transitional cell carcinoma, lymphoepithelioma-like carcinoma, verrucous carcinoma, condylomatous carcinoma and spindle cell carcinoma. Survival is most closely related to the stage of disease at the time of diagnosis.

curated.category: 血液系统恶性肿瘤 / 急性白血病
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 骨髓原始粒细胞爆发性增殖迅速抑制正常造血：未治患者常于数周至数月内死于致命性败血症/侵袭性真菌感染或颅内出血；急性早幼粒细胞白血病(APL/M3)及高白细胞淤滞症(>100×10^9/L)可在数小时至数日内因弥散性血管内凝血(DIC)或脑出血猝死。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: APL(M3)经ATRA+三氧化二砷(ATO)双诱导靶向分化治愈率已超90%；非M3年轻患者依托强化疗+异基因移植约40%–50%获长期生存；老年/TP53突变患者即便采用维奈克拉+阿扎胞苷仍高复发且5年生存率偏低。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: 约13.02万/年（成人最常见且最致命急性白血病，随老龄化死亡持续攀升）

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: NCC 2024报告2022年中国全白血病年新发81,900例、死亡50,100例（未单列AML）；GBD 2021显示1990–2021年中国AML标化死亡率下降约14.76%，仍占成人急性白血病死因主体

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 疑似APL立即给予口服全反式维A酸(ATRA)并积极输注血小板、冷沉淀及新鲜冰冻血浆纠治DIC防颅内出血；高白细胞血症立即水化碱化防肿瘤溶解综合征(TLS)并予羟基脲降白细胞或白细胞单采；粒缺发热1小时内经验性广谱抗假单胞菌β-内酰胺类抗感染。

master.definition_en: The Rh deficiency syndrome, also known as Rh-null syndrome, is a blood disorder where people have red blood cells (RBCs) lacking all Rh antigens. The Rh antigens maintain the integrity of the RBC membrane and therefore, RBCs which lack Rh antigens have an abnormal shape. There are two types of Rh deficiency syndrome: The regulator type is associated with many different changes (mutations) in the RHAG gene. The amorph type is caused by inactive copies of a gene (silent alleles) at the RH locus. As a result, the RBCs do not express any of the Rh antigens. The absence of the Rh complex alters the RBC shape, increases its tendency to break down (osmotic fragility), and shortens its lifespan, resulting in a hemolytic anemia that is usually mild. These patients are at risk of having adverse transfusion reactions because they may produce antibodies against several of the Rh antigens and can only receive blood from people who have the same condition. Rh deficiency syndrome is inherited in an autosomal recessive manner. Management is individualized according to the severity of hemolytic anemia.

master.definition_en: A rare superficial corneal dystrophy characterized by progressive opacity of the most anterior corneal layers. Slit-lamp examination reveals typical confluent translucent subepithelial deposits, extending in size and growing into clusters of golden droplets covering the cornea with disease progression. Patients present variably compromised visual acuity, depending on the stage of the disease. In advanced stages, decreased corneal sensation may lead to corneal trophic changes, perforation, and permanent visual loss.

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 睡梦与突发危象的实时监测预警

breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 需要发展连续无创可穿戴微循环/血氧/心电多模态传感器、血液微凝血活性快速试纸，结合 AI 在异常触发前几小时识别微血栓与高危信号并立即叫醒预警。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 时序多模态生理异常检测 + 血液高凝状态前置生物标志物发现 + 低成本家系表型筛查算法。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 急诊极危重期的快速再通与器官细胞保护
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把“几分钟决定生死”的抢救窗口拓宽成“几小时可救回”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 对急性心梗、脑梗死、脓毒性休克、急性肝衰竭与热射病而言，哪怕送到急诊室，微血管再灌注损伤、细胞因子风暴和不可逆线粒体坏死仍会在短时间内夺走生命。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 研发免复杂配型的超快精准溶栓与导管微取栓器械、阻断微血栓级联炎症风暴药物，以及在缺血缺氧期守住心肌与脑神经元存活的细胞保护剂。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 急性多器官微循环级联动力学建模、急诊快速炎症/凝血表型分型、老药新用紧急器官保护筛选。

master.definition_en: Ectasia of the left atrial appendage is a rare cardiac malformation characterized by the enlargement of the left auricle without any other associated cardiac lesions. It can be asymptomatic (discovered fortuitously during routine chest imaging as an unusual cardiac shadow) or present clinically with supraventricular tachyarrhythmia, paroxysmal tachycardia, embolic events, respiratory distress, chest pain, angina pectoris or heart failure.

master.name_en: pontocerebellar hypoplasia, hypotonia, and respiratory insufficiency syndrome, neonatal lethal
master.definition_en: A rare multiple congenital anomalies/dysmorphic syndrome characterized by pontocerebellar hypoplasia, hypotonia and respiratory insufficiency. Cardiac anomalies (particularly hypertrophic cardiomyopathy), eye manifestations (congenital cataracts, corneal clouding), seizures and facial dysmorphism (including microcephaly, bitemporal narrowing, absence of eyelashes, short palpebral fissures, small and low-set ears, anteverted nares, microstomia, and micrognathia) are present in the majority of the patients. Additional findings such as hepatosplenomegaly, edema, micropenis/cryptorchidism, hypoglycemia, hypernatremia, increased triglycerides, elevated plasma lactate and decreased plasma cholesterol were reported. Brain imaging may reveal simplified/delayed cortical gyration, dilated ventricles, and periventricular or diffuse white matter abnormalities. It is mostly caused by biallelic deletions in the ATAD3 gene cluster (ATAD3A, ATAD3B and ATAD3C) or by point mutations in the ATAD3A gene. Even though the syndrome is mostly neonatally lethal, some patients, regardless of the type of the mutation/deletion they harbor, may have a less severe condition and may survive.
mondo_categories: disease of genetic or genomic mechanism
